title: A server error during a bulk change shows Failed to update part status
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SRVERR-01) is active at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Deactivate parts.
  5. Click the {Part-A} row.
  6. Click the Deactivate button on the bar.
  7. Click Deactivate in the "Deactivate parts?" confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: When the system answers normally, a green toast reads "1 part updated." and {Part-A} leaves the Active tab.
  • Step 7: If the change fails on the server, a red error toast reads "Failed to update part status" with the second line "Please try again or contact support for help", it closes on its own after about 7 seconds, and the confirmation stays open so the change can be tried again.
  • Step 7: A server failure cannot be caused from the screen: write "server-error message not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S10-R12, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.4 (Confirm), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026), Phase 3 (Key code changes). Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, every part changed): “"{n} parts updated." ("1 part updated." for one) | Success toast, fades on its own”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change fails (server error)): “"Failed to update part status" with "Please try again or contact support for help" | Error toast, fades after 7 seconds”
  • S10-R12: “After a bulk change, the system shows how many parts changed and how many failed.”
  • Tech plan Phase 3 (Key code changes): “5xx → "Failed to update part status" / "Please try again or contact support for help", timeout 7000; rethrow keeps the confirm open”
